basic_details.job_title: CCI Medical Officer – FTC Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Cement Corporation of India Limited (CCI), a Government of India Enterprise, will hold a walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 (Thursday) for one Medical Officer on fixed term contract. Registration is at 03.00 pm and the interview is at 03.30 pm at CCI Ltd., Tandur Cement Factory, Karankote Village, Tandur Mandal, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501158. The maximum remuneration is Rs. 80,000 per month. The post is open to male and female candidates.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 65 years. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Retired persons from hospitals of Central/State/Army/PSU/Reputed Organizations/reputed Hospitals may also be considered.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MBBS degree from an institution recognized by Medical Council of India

qualification.details: MBBS degree from an institution recognized by Medical Council of India. Preference will be given to AFIH or DIH additional qualification candidates. Permanent registration with the Medical council of India/State Medical Council. Candidates who possess a medical degree from a college outside India should have passed FMGE (MCI screening test) and obtained medical council registration. Minimum two (02) years of experience after the date of completion of internship. Preference will be given to candidates attached to factories/industries or industrial experience. Should be fluent in Hindi, Telugu and English. | The maximum age limit is 65 years. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Retired persons from hospitals of Central/State/Army/PSU/Reputed Organizations/reputed Hospitals may also be considered. | Tenure: initially two years, extendable by another one year based on performance and requirement of the corporation. The contract can be terminated by the management as per the requirement of the corporation without assigning any notice. Accommodation: if required, the corporation will provide a quarter in the township at regular nominal rent and electricity charges during the contract period, to attend duties in shifts and during emergency requirement of the unit. Leave: 01 day paid leave per month during engagement. Place of posting: at Tandur Cement Factory or any place in India as per requirement. Pay: selected candidates are paid on lump-sum basis and are not eligible for ESI and EPF benefits. Maximum remuneration is Rs. 80,000 per month, with accommodation and electricity as per E-1 level category entitlement on nominal chargeable basis. Selected candidates are eligible for Executive cadre TA/DA when visiting out of station on official work.

important_instructions: The company will not provide accommodation and TA/DA to candidates appearing for the interview. Canvassing in any form, directly or indirectly, is liable to rejection and will disqualify the candidature. The management of CCI reserves the right to reject any candidature for incomplete information or for any other reason. The selected candidate should have a clear record, and engagement is based on receipt of vigilance clearance if engaged from Government/PSU. Candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage, or after engagement or joining, if any information provided is found false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria. The decision of the management for selection of candidates is final. For clarification, contact the HR department by email at [email protected] or mobile 8712620403. Resumes can be sent to the same email address.

content_sections.heading: About CCI
content_sections.text: Cement Corporation of India Ltd. describes itself as a premier profit making Central Govt. Public Sector Undertaking engaged in manufacturing and marketing of cement. This walk-in is for Tandur Cement Factory, at PO CCI Tandur, Dist. Vikarabad, Telangana – 501158, and is issued by its HR Department on 19.11.2026.

Leave: 01 day paid leave per month during engagement. Place of posting: at Tandur Cement Factory or any place in India as per requirement. Pay: selected candidates are paid on lump-sum basis and are not eligible for ESI and EPF benefits. Maximum remuneration is Rs. 80,000 per month, with accommodation and electricity as per E-1 level category entitlement on nominal chargeable basis. Selected candidates are eligible for Executive cadre TA/DA when visiting out of station on official work.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application form with a recent passport-size photograph affixed. The form can also be downloaded from www.cciltd.in/careers . Self-attested true copies of testimonials of educational qualifications, experience, date of birth, community, extra-curricular activities etc. All original documents in support of qualifications, age etc., to be produced at the time of or before the walk-in interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report to the venue at 03.00 pm on 26 November 2026 for registration. Selection is based on the walk-in interview. Candidates may also attend the interview online on the scheduled date and time against their request and after proper document verification; the link will be provided to them separately. Only interested scrutinized candidates may be allowed for the online interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CCI Medical Officer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 (Thursday), with registration at 03.00 pm and the interview at 03.30 pm.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the CCI walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at CCI Ltd., Tandur Cement Factory, Karankote Village, Tandur Mandal, Vikarabad District, Telangana 501158.

faq.question: Q3. How many Medical Officer vacancies are there at CCI?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Medical Officer – FTC (Full Time), open to male and female candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the CCI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: An MBBS degree from an institution recognized by Medical Council of India, permanent registration with the Medical council of India/State Medical Council, and minimum two years of experience after internship are required. Fluency in Hindi, Telugu and English is needed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CCI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years. Retired persons from Central/State/Army/PSU/reputed hospitals may also be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the CCI Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The fixed monthly pay is stated as negotiable, with maximum remuneration of Rs. 80,000 per month. Payment is on lump-sum basis.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should candidates bring to the CCI interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled-in application form with a recent passport-size photograph, self-attested copies of testimonials of qualifications, experience, date of birth, community and extra-curricular activities, and the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the CCI Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the walk-in interview at Tandur Cement Factory. Documents are verified, and scrutinized candidates may be allowed to attend the interview online.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CCI Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed term contract, initially for two years and extendable by another one year based on performance and requirement of the corporation.

faq.question: Q10. Are ESI, EPF or travel allowance given to the CCI Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are not eligible for ESI and EPF benefits. They are eligible for Executive cadre TA/DA when visiting out of station on official work, but candidates attending the interview get no TA/DA or accommodation.
